verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence close to bulk operations is a homepage anecdote in which the product's orchestrating agent dispatched 50 agents to handle 500 open issues. That implies parallel processing across many items but does not document a bulk-operations feature. The 'close all other sessions' terminal action is an adjacent UI control, and the REST API and CLI are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk-select or batch actions on items (conversations, tasks, agents, files), docs explaining how many-item operations work and their limits, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: I had 500 open issues. My CAO dispatched 50 agents. I went to bed.
